# freecenter_backups (Data Source)

Backups found on the connected hosts, newest first, optionally of one VM or on one host.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host_id` (String) Only the backups held by this host.
- `vm_name` (String) Only the backups of the VM with this name.

### Read-Only

- `backups` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backups))

<a id="nestedatt--backups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backups`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String)
- `datastore` (String)
- `host_id` (String)
- `id` (String) Usable as restore_from of freecenter_vm.
- `size_bytes` (Number)
- `stamp` (String)
- `vm_name` (String)
